scope: Focused owner-local relay recovery audit. No public route, ingress, execution gate, account state or provider workload changed.

audit.method: Source review, fixed-endpoint checks, exact Compose service-state inspection and bounded local acceptance; no failure injection.

findings.finding: When a Premium monitor or relay process stayed running but its fixed listener stopped responding, the supervisor's Compose up command could be a no-op. It would then repeat recovery without restarting that failed service.
findings.resolution: Recovery now identifies exactly one container by the accepted local Compose project and service labels. It restarts only a running/restarting failed service, starts a missing/created/exited/dead service through Compose, and stops on ambiguous state. Runtime restart still requires the temporary authorized handoff session, expiry of the observed central claim fence, healthy central services and a final unavailable-runtime check.

findings.finding: The supervisor could display a generic recovery category when a specific dependency had already failed its fixed health check.
findings.resolution: The supervisor retains the first failed dependency using the existing fixed central/monitor/relay allowlist.

hardening: Added an exact Compose project/service label check before selecting one local container for repair; unknown or ambiguous identities fail closed.
Added bounded, service-scoped recovery for stuck monitor and relay listeners. The missing/stopped path still uses Compose up, while a live-but-unresponsive service receives Compose restart.
Rechecked central health and runtime liveness after the existing ownership wait; no restart is attempted after an uncertain handoff or central health failure.
Preserved a fixed recovery category for the first failed local dependency and retained the existing jittered five-minute retry cap.

verification.productionBuild: npm run build passed; all 162 static pages generated.
verification.composeState: The exact galx-premium monitor and relay service labels resolved to one running container each. No Premium container was restarted or recreated during verification.
verification.hostStatus: At 2026-09-23T19:20:01Z, Docker Desktop, the Premium VM, both healthy central services, monitor and relay were healthy. Keep Premium online was enabled; the reloaded supervisor reported running, attempt 0, no recovery cause and an active AC sleep assertion at 100% charge.
verification.supervisorReload: The existing per-user LaunchAgent was kickstarted successfully. A fresh heartbeat confirmed the new source was loaded while all service containers remained running.
verification.diffCheck: git diff --check passed before the documentation review.

limits: The targeted restart branch was not fault-injected to preserve the user's always-on relay session; source decisions and healthy-state verification do not prove recovery from an injected failure.
The fixed listener checks establish process liveness only. They do not prove database, account, provider or model readiness.
Docker Desktop/Colima restart, sign-in, host reboot, sleep/wake, closed-lid and duplicate-owner drills remain open under ACT-018.
This is a single signed-in Mac and does not provide an independent host failure domain or public uptime guarantee.
